cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. My collapsed cake will make the next one look magnificent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. We'll begin the comeback with a new oven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An overnight oven installation. Now we have genuine suspense.
